title: PersonaSpec
description: An operator- or tenant-registered persona for the WaaV interaction agent (W2 section 3.4.1; integration decisions section 7). One spec is compiled by PersonaSpec::compile into: the front model's stable-prefix system prompt, the background preamble, the TTS settings for every speech lane, provider instructions for regimes B and C, the merged phrase banks and W4's templates. Clients never send a persona; they select one by id (optionally id@version) through interaction.front.persona and may set only the whitelisted caller fields. Every free-text field is length-capped, sanitised (newlines collapsed, reserved labels and special tokens removed) and guard-checked at compile time.

id.description: Registry id. (id, version) keys the stable prefix, so two calls of one persona version share a byte-identical cached prefix.

version.description: Version. Operator personas set it; tenant registration assigns the next version for new content and returns the existing one for identical content (W2 section 3.17).

name.description: The agent's spoken name, for example 'Ava'. Letters only, no digits. A protected term.

org.description: Organisation the agent speaks for, for example 'Northwind Travel'. No digits. A protected term.

role.description: Short role noun phrase, for example 'travel assistant'. Rendered in the Persona section of the front prompt.

channel.description: Where the persona speaks. Decides the backchannel default when backchannel_intensity is null (web medium, phone off; sign-off item 19).

language.description: BCP-47 tag of the persona language. English only in Releases 1 to 3; a persona whose language has no valid W4 policy pack runs with the interaction mode off (W4 section 3.13.1). Hindi packs arrive in Release 4.

tone.description: Tone word rendered into the front prompt and the background preamble.

formality.description: Register. A server-side caller formality (operator, budapp or a memory fact) may override it per call in the call header, never in the stable prefix.

max_words.description: Word cap for every front line. Also sets max_tokens = 12 + ceil(1.4 x max_words) for the LFM tokenizer (estimate; 33 tokens at 15 words).

answer_words.description: Word budget the background preamble asks the background to keep a spoken answer within unless the caller asked for detail (the {answer_words} slot of W2 section 3.4.7).

backend_capabilities.description: What the backend can do, rendered as 'Backend tools:' in the Delegation policy. In Bud mode, defaults to the humanised keys of tool_status_messages when the agent's front block gives none.

delegate_when.description: Extra 'Delegate to the backend when' bullets, appended after the gateway's fixed bullets.

do_not_delegate_when.description: Extra 'Do not delegate to the backend when' bullets, appended after the gateway's fixed bullets.

forbidden_topics.description: Topics the persona must not discuss. Rendered as a 'Refuse, and do not delegate, when the caller asks for' list in the front prompt (act refuse) and as a 'Never give' line in the background preamble. Packaging addition: W2's PersonaSpec carries refusal through the refuse bank and social_scope; this field makes the topics explicit.

social_scope.description: Small-talk topics the front may answer with a social line. Anything else social-sounding but request-shaped is converted to delegate by the rule layer.

backchannel_intensity.description: W5's four levels. null means the transport default (web medium, phone off; sign-off item 19). Rendered as the Backchannel policy sentence and read by W5's emitter.

backchannel_clips.description: Closed list of clip ids for the backchannel act (only with backchannel_via_model) and W5's ClipBank group. Each id must exist in the backchannel bank.

interruptibility.description: How readily the agent yields to caller speech; read by W5 (section 3.5.5). Not rendered into the front prompt.

utc_offset.description: Persona's local UTC offset for W1's TIME line, for example '+05:30'. A session's interaction.runtime.time.utc_offset wins. Never rendered into the stable prefix.

escalation.description: How the gateway may offer a person or a follow-up channel. Spoken only through W4 templates (failure.second's handoff_clause, finish_or_stop.with_channel, choice_offer); the front model has no handover act.

human_handoff.description: The operator configured a transfer to a person. When false no line may offer one.

handoff_phrase.description: Clause appended by failure.second, for example 'or I can put you through to reception'. Requires human_handoff.

continuation_channel.description: Channel W4 may promise a later result on; ChannelPromise lines are allowed only in W4 templates when this is configured.

continuation_phrase.description: W4's continuation_phrase, for example 'text you when it's done'. Requires a continuation_channel other than none.

approval_message.description: Line for a run paused on an approval the caller cannot give by voice; empty uses W4's approval_needed template.

sensitive.description: Per-persona W4 policy overrides for sensitive values (W4 section 3.8.7, within W4's clamps). Values in these categories are never taken or read back by voice.

extra_categories.description: Category labels added to W4's screening lexicon, for example 'date of birth'. Screening marks any Value or Form question naming one as sensitive; the reference grammar builder also suppresses copy spans of a caller utterance that names one.

channels.description: W4 sensitive_channels filter, in order. Voice is never a channel. With none available (always in Release 1) the request is declined with sensitive.decline.

banks.description: Overrides of phrase_banks.en.json groups. A group given here replaces the default list for this persona. Every line is compile-checked: no digits, money, dates, codes, names other than protected terms, no claim, outcome, ETA or channel words, no polar opener unless tagged polar, at least 4 lines per group (except restate_closers, stalled and social), acknowledgement clips at most 24 characters. A failure line needs its id in clip and its kind in subsituation (stall, hearing, exit, exit_follow_up, back); the kinds a persona leaves out keep the pack's lines.

template_overrides.description: Persona wording of W4 templates, keyed by template id from templates.en.json. W4's validator keeps every slot with the same type and order, refuses answer-lexicon phrases in question templates and claim words outside the template's backing event; W2's guard allows no entity outside protected terms.

lexicon.description: TTS respellings, mapped onto the gateway's Pronunciation {word, pronunciation} type and TTSConfig.pronunciations (gateway core/tts/base.rs:261-267, :291). Caller-profile pronunciations are merged after these.

voice.description: One voice for every speech lane, so the front's line and the background's verbatim answer sound like one speaker. The server's allow-list decides which providers and voices a tenant persona may use.

provider.description: TTS provider id as the gateway names it.

speed.description: Speaking rate (TTSConfig.speaking_rate allows 0.25 to 4.0; the persona range is narrower). A caller pace preference moves within it.

language.description: Voice language; defaults to the persona language.

protected_terms.description: Organisation, product and agent names the guard treats as known entities. Letters only: a persona cannot make a price or phone number speakable through this list.

bankLine.description: A bank line: a string, or an object with flags.

text.description: The line. '{{org}}' and '{{name}}' are the only slots allowed.

polar.description: The line affirms or denies; never used on a yes/no question except for its own social intent.

signed.description: Operator-signed: bypasses the entity rules (logged). Refused for tenant personas.

acts.description: Acts that may use this line; defaults to the group's acts.

intent.description: Social intent of a social line.

subsituation.description: Finer situation tag inside a group, for example caller_keeps_waiting.

clip.description: Clip id of a backchannel line.

w4_only.description: Spoken only by W4, never offered to the model.
